description: Six in-domain test-force endpoints used by the main-text accuracy-cost synthesis: four molecular endpoints from Table 4 and the two responsive MS25 solid-state endpoints from Table 5.
selection_rule: one checkpoint per model selected on validation Force MAE; test never selects

aggregation.endpoint_weighting: equal weight across six in-domain test endpoints
aggregation.normalization: divide each model Force MAE by the lowest observed Force MAE on that endpoint
aggregation.summary: geometric mean of six normalized Force MAEs

excluded.MS25 HEA Set1: not included in the responsive-domain synthesis because the response is host dependent
excluded.3BPA temperature transfer: retained as a separate appendix temperature-transfer study
